title: Phase 2 Cowork Brief: Sidebars, Orphans, Audio, Deploy

canonical_node.axiom: Every article in a series must be reachable and navigable within its series, and audio must be available for all processed articles.
definitions: Sidebar: fixed overlay navigation panel listing all articles in a series, with current article highlighted.
Orphan: an article deployed but not linked from its series hub or any other page.
Sticky nav: a navigation bar fixed at top of viewport for cross-series navigation.
TTS pipeline: text-to-speech processing producing MP3 files for articles.
derivation: Phase 1 completed sidebar, prev/next, and PI links for GTQ series.
Five other series lack in-series navigation, making their articles less discoverable.
Moral decline chapters are deployed but unreachable from the hub, violating the axiom.
Audio files are being generated; without wiring, they are not accessible to readers.
Therefore, tasks 4-8 are required to fulfill the axiom.
canonical_node.action: Implement sidebars for all five series, link orphaned chapters, add sticky nav to all articles, wire TTS audio players, and deploy changes.
boundary: Does not include creating new content or modifying article text.
Does not include fixing TTS pipeline errors or generating new audio.
Does not include redesigning site layout beyond specified components.
Does not include deploying to production until tasks are complete.
test: Each series has a sidebar with all articles listed and current highlighted.
Moral decline hub links to all chapters; each chapter has prev/next nav.
All non-GTQ articles have sticky nav with correct paths and colors.
Audio players appear on articles with MP3s and play correctly.
Deployment succeeds with no broken links.

dg1_dependencies: Phase 1 completed tasks (sidebar, prev/next, PI links)
Existing article files and hub pages
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Enables in-series navigation for five series, rescues orphaned chapters, provides consistent sticky nav, and integrates audio playback.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves existing GTQ sidebar functionality and all existing article content.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this, five series remain unnavigable, moral decline chapters remain orphaned, and audio is inaccessible, degrading user experience and content discoverability.

overstatement_risks: Assumes TTS pipeline will complete successfully without verification.
Assumes all files exist and are named as listed without checking.
Assumes sidebar CSS/JS is compatible with all target files.
kill_conditions: If TTS pipeline fails or produces incomplete output.
If any target file is missing or has incompatible structure.
If deployment fails due to Cloudflare configuration.
risk.lean_target: Implement sidebars and orphan rescue first; defer audio wiring until TTS output is verified.

plain_summary: This is a work plan for Phase 2 of a website project, detailing tasks to add navigation sidebars to five article series, link orphaned chapters, add sticky navigation, integrate audio players, and deploy. It is an operational instruction, not a scientific claim.
